explanation: A concept describing God's rest after six days of creation, symbolizing the completion of the work of creation.
A paradisiacal place created by God for Adam and Eve to live in, containing the tree of life and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.
The first man created by God from the dust of the ground, regarded as the ancestor of humanity.
The first woman created by God from Adam's rib, regarded as the mother of humanity.
A tree in the Garden of Eden representing eternal life and God's blessing.

word: Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil
explanation: A tree in the Garden of Eden representing human moral consciousness and the ability to distinguish between good and evil.
An agreement or pact between God and people, in this case a prohibition against eating from the tree of knowledge of good and evil.
